aliases: アフェランドラ・スクアロサ

light.best.quote: The zebra plant does best when it receives plenty of warm, bright, indirect light and high humidity.

light.min.reason: 出典に暗い場所（Deep shade）への耐性の記載がないため、明るい日陰の一段下までとした

temperature.minC.quote: The plant prefers high humidity and temperatures that do not dip below 65

temperature.idealC.quote: temperatures that do not dip below 65

temperature.idealC.reason: 上限は一般的な室温の範囲とした

watering.growing.quote: Do not allow the soil to dry out completely.

watering.winter.quote: Watering should be reduced but not stopped.

tips.ja: 水が多すぎても乾きすぎても、下葉が茶色くなって落ちる。
tips.quote: Excessive amounts of water, or extremely dry conditions, will cause the bottom leaves to brown and drop.

tips.ja: 花が咲かないときは、明るい間接光に長く当てる。
tips.quote: Encourage it by providing prolonged periods of indirect light.
